input.name: reads-without-a-measure-service
input.covers: Without an engine measure service every page loads at once onto the metric default (1:1 in metres, not persistent). The reads: the scale (a page not in the document reads the loading scale), the twins, the busy flag, the last reports, the presets, the units and the area units, the pending request. measureDistance and measureArea convert page points through the page geometry and read the page scale; a page not in the document throws not-found. getReadout reads a dimension annotation and answers not-dimension for an unknown ref. ensureLoaded resolves at once for a loaded page and rejects not-found for a page not in the document.

input.name: imperial-default-and-custom-presets
input.covers: defaultScale 'imperial' makes the fallback 1:1 in feet, and presets replaces the picker. A preset whose paper length is not 1 divides the real length by it.

input.name: custom-default-measure
input.covers: A PdfMeasure as defaultScale is the fallback as it is, whatever the page userUnit; setPreset scales the ratio by the page userUnit.

input.name: measure-service-viewports
input.covers: With the engine's measure service each page reads its viewports. An owned viewport wins wherever it is; otherwise the viewport under the crop's centre (the last containing one) is a foreign scale, one without a measure reads null, and a page whose viewports miss the centre falls back to the default. Every page is persistent. canMeasure is ready on each; a foreign scale gives readouts of foreign-measure.

input.name: viewport-reads-fail-refresh-and-rehydrate
input.covers: A refused viewport read leaves the page not ready with the serialized error; ensureLoaded retries it. A page.viewportsChanged event re-reads that page (one not in the document is refused quietly), stream.desynced and document.versioned re-read every page, and any other event is ignored. While a read is in flight the page reads not ready with its previous scale.

input.name: refresh-epochs
input.covers: Viewport reads carry an epoch per page: an older read that answers after a newer one began is dropped, whether it resolves or rejects, and ensureLoaded joins the read in flight rather than starting another.

input.name: set-scale-on-one-page
input.covers: Without a measure service setScale publishes an owned 'EmbedPDF' viewport over the crop, keeping foreign ones, re-measures the page's dimensions through the annotation plugin and announces the change; isBusy is true while it runs and listLastReports keeps the reports. recalculate false skips the re-measure and reports the scale alone. clearScale drops the owned viewport and re-measures with the default. A single-page change rejects: a measure that is not writable, and a page not in the document.

input.name: set-scale-on-several-pages
input.covers: 'all' and a list of pages change each page and report per page: a page that fails (not in the document, a measure that is not writable, a scale without a rectilinear base) reports scaleError instead of rejecting. A list of one page is still strict.

input.name: set-scale-preflight
input.covers: A single-page setScale runs the write preflight and rejects with its message: a conversion that is not positive, a precision that is not a whole number or is past the int32 range, a format whose unit is not a string, a text member that is not a string, a missing distance list, and an origin outside the PDF float range. A decimal format without a precision defaults to 100, and a label position, a fixed flag, a finite origin and a positive CYX all pass. calibrate writes the ratio rounded to eight significant digits.
input.reason: Pins the setScale preflight refusals, through the settled rejections. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: units-precision-and-presets
input.covers: setUnit, setAreaUnit and setPrecision edit the page's rectilinear scale (the default counts) and write it back; a fractional last format restarts at a precision of 100. An invalid precision, a base unit that is not a length unit, and an unknown preset reject; setPreset writes the preset's ratio.

input.name: service-writes-and-foreign-scales
input.covers: With a measure service a scale write goes to the engine, then the page re-reads its viewports. A refused engine write rejects a single-page change, and the next change on that page still runs. Unit and precision edits need a rectilinear scale: a foreign one, or a viewport without a measure, rejects not-ready. Two changes on one page queue behind each other.

input.name: calibration-flow
input.covers: startCalibration clears any request and arms the calibrate tool. The tool's captured line becomes the pending request in page space (the pointer tool comes back, onCalibrationRequested fires); calibrate derives the scale from the known length, writes it, clears the request for its page and fires onCalibrationCompleted. A request on another page survives a calibrate elsewhere; dismissCalibration drops it and fires onCalibrationDismissed, and is silent with nothing pending. applyTo widens the write. Two identical points reject invalid-input; a page not in the document rejects not-found. A capture tool other than calibrate is ignored.

input.name: zero-length-capture
input.covers: A calibrate tool configured to click-create a zero-length line captures it, and a zero-length capture makes no request.

input.name: without-authority
input.covers: Read-only: canCalibrate and canMeasure are false, every scale change rejects permission-denied before touching a page, startCalibration does nothing, and createMeasurement rejects permission-denied.

input.name: create-measurement
input.covers: createMeasurement creates a line (distance), a polyline (perimeter) or a polygon (area) through the annotation plugin, with the kind's own tool unless one is named. A distance needs exactly two points; a page whose scale is not known rejects not-ready.

input.name: listener-throws
input.covers: A throwing listener goes to console.error('[measurement] listener failed:', error); the change still resolves. An unsubscribed listener hears nothing more.

input.name: pages-inserted-and-removed
input.covers: A page inserted after the plugin connected loads its viewports; a structural event that keeps the same pages loads nothing. A page removed while its viewport read is in flight is not published, and a later change on it rejects not-found.

input.name: page-removed-while-a-change-waits
input.covers: Without a measure service, a preset change queued behind another on the same page finds the page gone once it runs: the ratio falls back to a userUnit of 1 and the write rejects not-found.

input.name: close-mid-flight
input.covers: Closing the document while changes run: a single-page change rejects with the engine call's instance-closed, a multi-page change whose pages all reported rejects not-ready (the plugin is disposed), neither touches the busy counter again, and a viewport read in flight is not published.

input.name: reduce-pending-floors-at-zero
input.covers: The busy counter never goes below zero.

input.name: reduce-unknown
input.covers: An unknown action returns the same state.

input.name: select-beside-the-centre
input.covers: A viewport that spans the centre's height but not its x is not under it.

input.name: select-on-a-raised-crop
input.covers: The centre of a crop that does not start at 0 is the midpoint of its bottom and top.

input.name: with-unit-keeps-precision
input.covers: A decimal last format keeps its precision.

input.name: initial-state-and-twins
input.covers: A fresh slice is idle with no result. canMark is annotation create authority; canApply needs the engine service and all three of doc.redact, doc.pages.modify and doc.annotate.modify.

input.name: mark-the-text-selection
input.covers: queueCurrentSelection creates one redact markup per selected page from the segment quads, with the redact preset, clears the selection and resolves true; the marks then read back as text-kind pending items.

input.name: marking-needs-create-authority
input.covers: Without annotation create authority canMark is false and queueCurrentSelection resolves false without creating or clearing anything.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: the-redact-tool
input.covers: enableRedact activates the composed redact tool; isRedactActive follows it; toggleRedact switches between redact and pointer. A drag off text under the tool draws an area mark, pending as area-kind.

input.name: without-a-selection-plugin
input.covers: Without the selection plugin the composed redact tool never registers: enableRedact and toggleRedact throw the hub’s unknown-tool error, and queueCurrentSelection resolves false.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: pending-projection
input.covers: getPending projects every loaded redact annotation in page order: its model id (obj: and nm:), ref, page, display index, area or text kind, and overlay label. preparePending asks the annotation plane for every page and resolves.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: estimate-collateral
input.covers: estimateCollateral counts the non-redact annotations whose rect has positive-area overlap with a mark’s quads (else its rect), for all marks, for the named ones, and for none.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: apply-named-marks
input.covers: apply(ids) sends the matching pending refs as an annotations scope; the slice is applying until the engine answers, then records the result, fires onApplied and resolves with it. The unsubscribe stops later notifications and answers whether it removed anything.

input.name: apply-all-pages
input.covers: applyAll sends every page of the document as a pages scope, including pages without marks.

input.name: apply-refused
input.covers: An engine refusal ends the apply with a null result, which keeps the last result, and rejects with the engine’s error.

input.name: apply-refusals-before-the-engine
input.covers: apply rejects when no pending id matches (an empty list, no argument, an unknown id); applyAll rejects for a document with no pages; both reject without the engine redaction service. None of them dispatches.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: remote-applies-arrive-as-events
input.covers: A redaction.applied event from a remote origin is recorded as the last result and fires onApplied; a local one (own applies flow through apply) and other event types are ignored. Closing the document releases the subscription.

input.name: a-throwing-listener-is-isolated
input.covers: A throwing onApplied callback is reported to console.error and the next callback still runs.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: set-label
input.covers: setLabel writes the label fields the patch names (null clears the text) and always carries the mark’s current font family, size, colour and alignment; it rejects for a non-redact annotation and for an unknown ref.

input.name: mark-area-and-page
input.covers: markArea creates a redact annotation over a page-space rectangle with the redact tool and the configured overlay look (fill, label colour, family, and a size of 0); markPage covers the whole page. onPendingChanged fires for each redact creation and not for a square. markPage of a page the document lacks throws not-found; without create authority markArea and markPage throw permission-denied.

input.name: an-overlay-without-values-adds-nothing
input.covers: An overlay config whose fill and text members are all absent adds no props to a mark. A document with pages but no marks lists none.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: mark-search-matches
input.covers: markMatches runs the search and creates one redact mark per hit from its segment quads, in hit order, skipping hits without segments; a pages filter keeps only the hits on those pages. Without a config the marks carry no overlay props.

input.name: marking-refusals
input.covers: markMatches rejects unsupported without a search plugin and permission-denied without create authority; markSelection rejects unsupported without a selection plugin once authority is there.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: unmark-and-clear
input.covers: unmark deletes the refs that are pending marks through the annotation plane and reports every other ref as skipped; with no marks among them it resolves without touching the engine. clearPending unmarks every mark; a refused delete lands in failed. onPendingChanged fires once per deleted mark, with its page.

input.name: apply-pages
input.covers: applyPages rejects invalid-input for no pages and otherwise sends the given pages as a pages scope.

input.name: pending-reads
input.covers: getPending finds a mark by any ref kind and answers null for a non-mark; listPending with a page filter reads only that page (a page the document lacks has none), a filter without a page reads them all, and repeated reads answer the same marks. getPendingCount counts one page or all.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: update-label-refused
input.covers: An engine refusal of a label edit rejects as a redaction PluginError; a later edit that lands fires onPendingChanged for the mark’s page.
input.reason: Pins refusals, pending projections and collateral estimates, through call outcomes and settlements. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: started-keeps-the-last-result
input.covers: APPLY_STARTED sets applying and keeps lastResult.

input.name: finished-with-null-keeps-the-result
input.covers: A failed apply (result null) clears applying and keeps the previous result.

input.name: finished-when-idle
input.covers: APPLY_FINISHED always makes a new state, even when nothing changes.

input.name: unknown-action
input.covers: An action outside the union returns the same state.

input.name: no-document
input.covers: Without a document there are no pages, so nothing is counted.

input.name: touching-edges-do-not-count
input.covers: Intersection needs positive area: shared edges and corners are not collateral.

input.name: quads-replace-the-rect
input.covers: A mark with quads targets the quads’ boxes only, not its /Rect.

input.name: one-annotation-counts-once
input.covers: An annotation under several marks is one piece of collateral.

input.name: pages-in-document-order
input.covers: Only pages in the document are counted, each against its own marks.

input.name: create-update-and-delete-libraries
input.covers: createLibrary writes a blank seed's /Title and catalog PieceInfo and keeps the saved bytes; a preferred id is kept unless taken; kind and categories ride along. updateLibrary rewrites the title only when the name changes and the PieceInfo always; an unknown id rejects NotFound. exportLibrary copies the canonical bytes or rejects not-found. The library events and the change signal fire for each; filtered reads select by one kind or several.

input.name: library-writes-that-fail
input.covers: A library whose save answered nothing has no canonical bytes: updating it or one of its assets rejects Unknown. A raster whose size is not positive rejects InvalidArg. A seed without named pages rejects NotImplemented before any write, and a failed save rejects after the close, adding nothing.

input.name: import-a-registered-library
input.covers: A library whose /Names /Pages registry names its pages imports those keys as identifier and label, in page order whatever the key order; its /Title names it, its catalog kind and locale read back; a registration that is not a page is ignored with a warning; nothing is registered again.

input.name: registry-refusals
input.covers: A registry key with an empty identifier or a repeated one rejects InvalidArg naming it; an engine that reports no registry at all rejects NotImplemented; a library kind the plugin does not define is kept as written.

input.name: marks-become-assets
input.covers: createAsset authors an ink mark (its box padded by the stroke, the colour parsed) or a typed one (a generous box, the default colour) on a scratch page and exports its appearance as the asset's page; an image mark is a raster; a PDF mark is used whole, or one page of it extracted. Without a name the identifier is minted Acrobat-style from Math.random, and the label defaults to it.

input.name: marks-that-are-refused
input.covers: Both a source and a mark, or neither, reject InvalidArg; a colour that is not #rrggbb (a name, five hex digits, six that are not hex) and an ink mark with no points reject InvalidArg after the scratch document closes; a PDF mark's missing page, a negative index included, rejects InvalidArg naming the page count. An identifier that is empty or holds '=' rejects InvalidArg.

input.name: an-ink-mark-with-defaults
input.covers: An ink mark with no colour or stroke width takes the defaults (#1d2b53, 2); a scratch document with no page rejects Unknown after closing.

input.name: edit-move-and-copy-assets
input.covers: updateAsset renames the registry entry only when the label changes, rewrites the page PieceInfo, and clears the subject for null; an unknown asset rejects NotFound. duplicateAsset appends a copy of the page with a minted identifier and a ' copy' label (or the one given); moveAsset copies into another library and removes the original, returns the id itself for the same library, and rejects not-found for an unknown asset, as duplicateAsset does. A second asset of the same name rejects InvalidArg.

input.name: edits-queued-behind-removals
input.covers: An asset edit queued behind the removal of that asset, and a library edit queued behind the removal of that library, find their target gone when their turn comes and reject NotFound. A move and a copy of an asset carry its subject, categories and preview.

input.name: copies-carry-their-metadata
input.covers: moveAsset and duplicateAsset pass the asset's subject, categories and preview to the copy.

input.name: raster-pages-that-fail
input.covers: A raster page whose flatten does not apply rejects Unknown, and an asset engine without pages.flatten rejects NotImplemented; both close the library copy and add nothing.

input.name: an-asset-from-annotations
input.covers: createAssetFromAnnotations exports the selected annotations' appearance from the open document as the source of a new asset; a mark passed beside it rides the spread into createAsset, which rejects InvalidArg for a source and a mark; a document that is not open rejects NotFound.

input.name: rendered-previews
input.covers: renderAssetPreview opens the asset's page bytes, renders its first page at the width asked and closes, caching the render per width; a render that fails is reported and falls back to the cached thumbnail; a copy with no pages answers null; a render with no content type reads as image/png; an unknown asset rejects not-found. Removing the asset drops its renders.

input.name: place-without-the-pointer
input.covers: placeAsset hands the target's annotation plugin the asset's payload and the placement and answers the placed annotation's ref; an unknown asset rejects NotFound. placeAssetOnPages places on every page or the ones listed, reporting each failure by its page as a stamp PluginError.

input.name: the-armed-asset
input.covers: getArmedAsset answers the asset this plugin armed while the annotation plugin still holds a stamp, and null once a tool change dropped it or nothing was armed; disarm announces a change only when something was armed. canPlace follows the target's annotation create grant, the active document when none is named; canImport is optimistic.

input.name: can-place-without-a-document
input.covers: canPlace with no document named and none active answers false.

input.name: restore-stored-libraries
input.covers: restoreStampLibraries imports every stored library as it is and answers their ids; one that fails to import is reported and skipped. A store whose list rejects rejects the restore.

input.name: a-store-that-cannot-list
input.covers: A store whose list rejects rejects the restore with that error.

input.name: persist-library-changes
input.covers: persistStampLibraries writes a library's exported PDF to the store once its changes stop for the debounce, a burst coalescing into one write; a removal deletes the stored copy at once and drops a pending write; an excepted library is never stored. The stop function unsubscribes and flushes pending writes immediately.

input.name: stop-flushes-a-write-still-pending-behind-another
input.covers: A write that fires drops only its own pending timer, and a library changed while another is pending gets its own timer: after one library's write lands, stopping flushes the other's pending write at once, and nothing is written twice.

input.name: persistence-failures-are-reported
input.covers: A store write or delete that rejects is reported with the library id and leaves the stream running; the default debounce is 250 ms.

input.name: a-raster-asset-is-sniffed-and-previews-itself
input.covers: addAsset without a library sniffs a PNG's or JPEG's size, keeps its bytes as its own preview, and adds a loose single-asset library named after it; kind, subject and categories ride along.

input.name: supplied-previews-and-sizes
input.covers: An explicit size wins over the sniffed one; a supplied preview wins over the raster's own bytes and keeps its payload MIME type, which defaults to image/png when absent or empty.

input.name: a-loose-pdf-needs-a-size
input.covers: A PDF added without a library needs size (PDF bytes carry none): without it the call rejects and nothing is added; with it the asset is a vector with no preview unless one is supplied.

input.name: asset-sources-that-are-refused
input.covers: An unknown libraryId rejects with NotFound before reading the source; bytes that are not PNG, JPEG or PDF reject with InvalidArg; a non-source rejects with resolveBinarySource's TypeError, and a bad preview with its own.

input.name: into-an-existing-loose-library
input.covers: addAsset with a loose library's id queues on that library and appends the asset; an empty libraryId is no library at all.

input.name: appends-a-page-to-a-canonical-library
input.covers: addAsset on a canonical library reopens its canonical bytes, inserts the PDF, writes the page PieceInfo, extracts and renders the new page, saves the rewritten library and closes; the asset takes the inserted page size.

input.name: a-supplied-preview-skips-the-render
input.covers: An append with a supplied preview keeps it and renders nothing; the kind defaults to stamp.

input.name: appends-that-are-refused
input.covers: A raster joins a canonical library as a page of its own (v2 refused it before any engine call; here the workshop document takes that append). An insert of more than one page, an inserted page missing from the layout, a document without page pieceInfo and an inserted page the handle does not know each reject after closing the document, adding nothing.

input.name: an-unsaved-append-changes-nothing
input.covers: A save that fails rejects the append after closing; the store and the canonical bytes are as they were, and the next append starts from them.

input.name: a-save-that-answers-nothing
input.covers: An engine whose save and extract answer nothing leaves the library with no canonical bytes and the asset with none: the selectors read null, and an append or a removal on that library rejects with Unknown before opening anything.

input.name: removes-a-canonical-page-first
input.covers: removeAsset on a canonical library with other assets deletes its page from the canonical bytes and saves them before the descriptor goes; an unknown id resolves and does nothing.

input.name: removing-the-last-page-drops-the-library
input.covers: Removing a canonical library's only asset drops the whole library instead of saving a zero-page PDF; a loose asset goes without any engine call and leaves its library.

input.name: a-failed-page-delete-keeps-the-asset
input.covers: A delete or save that fails rejects removeAsset after closing, and the asset, its binaries and the canonical bytes stay.

input.name: removals-are-serialized-per-library
input.covers: Removals on one library run one after the other: the first rewrite leaves one page, so the queued second drops the library rather than saving an empty PDF, and a third for the same asset finds it gone and does nothing. A removal on another library does not wait.

input.name: remove-library
input.covers: removeLibrary drops the library, its assets, their binaries and its canonical bytes; an unknown id still dispatches LIBRARY_REMOVED, which changes nothing.

input.name: an-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
input.covers: An append queued behind a removal and a removeLibrary of the same library finds it gone when its turn comes and rejects with NotFound; the removal's rewrite still lands first.

input.name: a-loose-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
input.covers: A session id is not checked against the store: a loose library created while a canonical removal on the same id is in flight replaces the canonical one. A loose append queued behind that removal and a removeLibrary finds the library gone and rejects with NotFound.

input.name: a-loose-append-finds-its-library-canonical
input.covers: A loose append queued on a library that an import has since replaced with a canonical one finds a library that is not loose when its turn comes, and rejects with NotFound.

input.name: a-loose-asset-under-a-canonical-id
input.covers: An import that lands after a loose library took its embedded id replaces the library with the canonical one; removing the loose asset then finds a canonical library it has no page in and rejects with Unknown.

input.name: a-queued-mutation-after-destroy
input.covers: A mutation still queued when the kernel is destroyed runs against a destroyed store: the in-flight removal's dispatch lands nowhere, and the queued append's read of the state throws a TypeError.

input.name: imports-every-page-as-a-vector-asset
input.covers: importLibraryPdf opens the bytes on the asset engine, reads catalog and page PieceInfo, writes the normalized metadata back, extracts and renders every page, keeps the saved PDF as the canonical bytes, closes the document, and only then adds the library and its assets; the selectors read them back in order.

input.name: reads-ids-and-display-metadata-from-pieceinfo
input.covers: Catalog Id, Name and Categories become the library's; page Id, Name, Kind (a name, matched case-insensitively), Subject and Categories become each asset's. An empty string, a Kind that is a string rather than a name, an unknown Kind and a non-array Categories are ignored.

input.name: a-name-kind-and-stamp-kinds-read-back
input.covers: Kind 'stamp' reads as a stamp and an empty name as no kind; the default library name is 'Stamps'.

input.name: import-options-override-the-pdf
input.covers: opts.name, opts.categories and opts.kind win over PieceInfo (an empty name and empty categories included); opts.assetName names each page by index, and a nullish answer falls back to PieceInfo's Name, then to 'Stamp <n>'.

input.name: a-payload-source-and-its-errors
input.covers: A {data, mimeType} payload is read for its bytes; a non-PDF (PNG, JPEG, unknown bytes) rejects with InvalidArg before any engine call; a source that is not bytes or a payload rejects with the TypeError resolveBinarySource throws.

input.name: a-cloud-kernel-engine-names-the-fix
input.covers: With no assetEngine configured, an InvalidArg from the kernel engine's open becomes a NotImplemented naming the assetEngine option, and canImport turns false after it; any other open error rejects as it is.

error.name: EngineError
error.message: cloud engine supports OpenInput kind 'token' or 'id'

input.name: a-configured-engine-keeps-its-invalid-arg
input.covers: A configured asset engine that refuses bytes rejects with its own InvalidArg: the configuration hint is only for the kernel engine.

input.name: missing-services-refuse-before-any-write
input.covers: An asset document without catalog pieceInfo, or without page pieceInfo, rejects with NotImplemented before listing or before any read; one with no pages rejects with InvalidArg; a listed page the document does not know throws from page(). Every one closes the document and adds nothing.

input.name: an-engine-failure-mid-import-adds-nothing
input.covers: A failed metadata write, extraction, render or save rejects the import with the engine error, still closes the document, and leaves the store and the binaries untouched.

input.name: a-failed-close-fails-the-import
input.covers: A close that rejects in the finally rejects the whole import, after a successful save, and nothing is added.

input.name: previews-must-be-inline-bytes
input.covers: A render whose source is a URL rejects with NotImplemented (asset engines must be local); a render without a content type caches a preview without a MIME type; previewWidth sets the render width.

input.name: a-render-with-no-image-throws
input.covers: A render that answers null, or an image whose source is null, rejects the import with the TypeError reading 'source' or 'kind' off null.

input.name: a-second-import-allocates-fresh-ids
input.covers: Importing the same canonical library twice keeps the embedded ids the first time and allocates session ids the second, since both are taken; an embedded id equal to the next session id makes the allocator draw again.

input.name: ids-carry-the-clock
input.covers: Session ids are the prefix, Date.now() in base 36, and a counter in base 36.

input.name: concurrent-imports-read-the-store-before-either-lands
input.covers: Two imports whose reads both precede either dispatch allocate the same embedded ids: the second LIBRARY_ADDED and ASSET_ADDED overwrite the first. With different library ids and one shared asset id, removing the asset leaves the first library listing an id with no asset, which the selectors skip.

input.name: an-asset-engine-factory-is-called-once
input.covers: A factory is called on the first import, not at start, and memoized for the second; kernel destroy destroys the engine it produced, after the documents close.

input.name: an-async-asset-engine-factory
input.covers: A factory may answer a promise of an engine; it is awaited per open and destroyed on teardown.

input.name: a-throwing-asset-engine-factory-is-retried
input.covers: A factory that throws rejects the import with its error and is called again next time; teardown has no engine to destroy.

input.name: a-rejecting-asset-engine-factory-is-memoized
input.covers: A factory whose promise rejects is memoized as that rejection: the second import rejects without calling it, and teardown swallows it.

input.name: an-engine-instance-is-not-destroyed
input.covers: A configured engine instance is used as is and left alone at teardown, as is the kernel engine; teardown drops every binary.

input.name: the-plugin-factory-defaults
